prerequisites: Mastering material that is taught, 2 tests

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding standard speech about familiar matters that a student meets at work, at school, during free time, and talking about these topics.
Ability to describe experiences and events, briefly explain one's opinions and plans.
Reading and understanding general and technical texts.

syllabus_topics: Grammar: review of declination of nouns, and adjectives, pronouns, numerals, verbs, conditional, prepositions, connectors
Conversation: food, drinks, work, leisure, aspects of life, institutions, economics, industry, finances, services
Technical Czech: materials, description of an instrument and a process, parts of a car, maintenance, definitions, CV
bibliography: Holá, Bořilová: Česky krok za krokem 1
internal materials of the Department of Languages
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
